numerical_scope: Successful implant installation in ordinary MobClass.BodyTypes generation, only when the body is resolved and no viable random augmentation can change it. Preset augmentation socket ranges and uniformly selected ordinary body variants are integrated.
selection_order: preset augmentations with atomic slot conflicts
possible random augmentation body changes (conditional, no numeric distribution)
random implant selection filtered by slot existence
installation filtered by nature and remaining sockets
random_augmentation_scope: Conservative union of original and possible replacement slots. Guaranteed conflicts are excluded. Random conflicts/health thresholds and their joint sequence probabilities are not solved; retained sources are marked Conditional.
failure_policy: Hide numeric probability for unsupported game assembly, unresolved body/rule data, ambiguous duplicate slot types, non-positive/invalid selector weights or roll counts outside 0..64. Never normalize after removing a post-selection installation failure.
runtime_data_scope: Game DLLs reveal algorithms but the supplied evidence does not include live Data.Items, MobClasses or BodyTypes tables. No exact Ksio/psycho pair has been confirmed.
manual_evidence_export: Select an implant after Loot warmup and press Ctrl+Shift+F10; diagnostics_report.txt gains EnemyImplantEvidence. No Modder Mode or game RNG required.

validation.oracle: Independent enumeration of full choice sequences then installation; also averages uniform socket ranges and tests typed record-adapter fixtures.
